 20 Great Performances TRAPPED In Terrible Movies
 WhatCulture Follow noreply@whatculture.com (Scott Banner) Add to Preferred Sources Updated Wed, November 4, 2026 at 1:19 PM UTC 20 Great Performances TRAPPED In Terrible Movies Wouldn't it be wonderful if every movie you paid to see turned out to be an instant classic? No one wants to see a bad film, but the fact is that there will always be bad films that will end up disappointing audiences almost universally.
 However, just because something isn't good doesn't mean that there can't be value found in it. Particularly when it comes to cinema, there is no reason to believe that a terrible movie can't have some saving grace, be it one stand out scene, a great tease for a sequel, or one great performance.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement This list will focus on the latter, where actors have given their everything to a role within a project that quite frankly didn't deserve it. There's countless times were a single performance has been the best aspect of a good project, but when everything else around it is bad the actor's work itself can often get lost.
 Whether a final girl doing everything she can to keep a poor slasher afloat, an actor playing double duty with two vastly different roles at once, or an exciting new superhero bogged down in the mire of a weak origin story, there are plenty of times just one actor has come away from a cinematic disappointment with their head held high.
